title: Marketplace and HACS Repository Manifest (hacs.json)
description:
JSON schema for the hacs.json file that the Home Assistant Marketplace (2026.11+) and HACS read for repository metadata, release settings, and distribution options of custom integrations, dashboard plugins, themes, and templates.
https://contributors.home-assistant.io/marketplace/reference/hacs-json/

name.description: The display name shown in the Marketplace and HACS

content_in_root.description: Indicates whether the content is in the root of the repository as opposed to in a subdirectory

zip_release.description: Indicates whether the content is in a zipped archive when releases are published on GitHub (only supported for integrations)

filename.description: Name of the file HACS should look for (only applies to single item types: plugin, theme, template, python_scripts, zip_release)

hide_default_branch.description: Do not offer the default branch as an installable version

oneOf.description: Two character country code in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format
Array of two character country codes in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format

homeassistant.description: The minimum Home Assistant version a release needs (append 'b0' to allow that release's betas). Only checked for repositories with releases; older versions are offered instead.

hacs.description: The minimum HACS version. The Marketplace reads it but does not compare it; HACS before Home Assistant 2026.11 still does.

persistent_directory.description: A relative path (within the integration directory) that will be kept safe during upgrades (can only be used with integrations)

render_readme.description: Not read by the Marketplace or current HACS versions; the README is always rendered.
